description: Defines the Simulator class for scheduling actors in a QUIC protocol simulation environment, including methods for scheduling, running, and managing simulation time and actors.

classes.name: Simulator
classes.description: Manages scheduling and execution of actors in a network simulation environment, providing utilities like clock, RNG, and alarms.

classes.name: Simulator::Clock
classes.description: Provides current simulation time and wall time, used internally by Simulator.

classes.name: Simulator::RunForDelegate
classes.description: Handles alarm callbacks for RunFor() execution control.

methods.name: Simulator
methods.description: Constructor with a custom QuicRandom generator.

methods.name: Simulator::Schedule
methods.description: Schedules an actor to run at a specified simulation time.

methods.name: Simulator::Unschedule
methods.description: Removes an actor from the schedule.

methods.name: Simulator::enable_random_delays
methods.description: Checks if random delays are enabled.

methods.name: Simulator::RunUntil
methods.description: Runs the simulation until a predicate is true or schedule is empty.

methods.name: Simulator::RunUntilOrTimeout
methods.description: Runs the simulation until a predicate is true or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: Simulator::RunFor
methods.description: Runs the simulation for a specified duration.
